name: zarchive_list_get_at
description: zArchiveList::GetAt returns the payload at an index in the circular archive list, null for null or index >= count, and preserves the retail wrap behavior for negative or over-count circular walks.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cb30 validates the __fastcall ECX=list EDX=index ABI, null-list return, index >= count return, direct head payload return for index zero, circular next traversal from head->next, and no negative-index guard.

The native smoke verifies null-list and index >= count null returns, payload lookup for indices 0 through 2, negative-index wrap to the head payload, and wrap-to-head behavior when the list count exceeds the actual circular node distance.
